key_insight: Lattice surgery enabled logical-state teleportation between two distance-three surface-code qubits on a 41-physical-qubit superconducting circuit.
engineering_relevance: The results inform gate-sequence and timing choices for implementing operations between logical qubits in fault-tolerant quantum processors.
method: Merge two surface-code patches using lattice surgery.
Track logical observables to characterize information transfer from source to target.
Repeat stabilizer measurements and optimize gate count and sequence duration.
evidence_signal: The experiment found that repeated post-merge stabilizer measurements restored fault tolerance and increased teleportation fidelity, with further gains from protocol optimization.
watch_item: The demonstration uses distance-three codes; the abstract provides no numerical fidelities or evidence of scaling to larger logical circuits.
paper_title: Teleportation of Logical Qubits using Lattice Surgery with Superconducting Circuits
